review_scope: Reviewed workload deployment scope and role-evidence decisions for the 2026-08-20 Verified Construction Core v0.2 preview.

workload_scope_bindings.semantic_scope: The project-specific release expressly names both cloud and artificial-intelligence infrastructure. This supports one mixed intended project workload only; it does not establish an operational workload, training-versus-inference split, HPC deployment, tenant, customer, user, hardware model, or workload share.

The second facility is explicitly purpose-built for high-density AI training and inference workloads, supporting intended ai_training and ai_inference classifications. These do not establish installed accelerators, named models, tenant identity, current compute activity, utilization, or workload shares.

role_bindings.semantic_scope: Akashi says it is being built in Astana and identifies its team as building and operating the campus, supporting developer and intended operator roles without asserting operation.

The project-linked official disclosure presents Taurus as AVAIO's development, and its accompanying company description identifies AVAIO Digital as a developer and operator of data centers. This supports AVAIO Digital Partners as developer and operator only; no owner, landlord, tenant, user, customer, utility, contractor, or investor role is inferred.

CoreSite describes its own campus expansion and future facility services, supporting CoreSite as developer and intended operator. The retained specification says power is to be provided by Xcel, supporting Xcel Energy as intended utility. These roles do not prove ownership, current operation, service availability, occupancy, or energized supply.

The disclosure identifies the facility as Edged US's second Chicago-campus data center and says Edged US builds and operates data centers. This supports Edged US as developer and intended operator for the campus and ORD01-2 without implying that the unfinished project is operating. FCL Builders remains construction-partner attribution and is not assigned a standardized role here.
